limitations: Final report describes this finite local MLX Vero-style transfer study only, not official checkpoint equivalence or universal Vero efficacy.
No stable cross-seed multi-task advantage is established; positive individual endpoints are not selected for continuation from final100.
No new formal candidate/no-image/swapped tests were executed; prior dev controls remain separate.
Task-level patient/cycle bootstrap is descriptive and not multiplicity-corrected or simultaneous macro/worst-task coverage.
Cross-source global identity, absent pretraining exposure, clinical and brain-only correspondence claims remain unsupported.
Prior developer controls and gradient findings are referenced as previously verified evidence; this review does not repeat those native experiments.
